neighbours.label: the negative or diminishing word right after a negator in a double-negative boost meaning 'very much so' (no less/fewer than, none other than, not un-X, no small feat, nothing short of, not without, do not hesitate, never fail, not afraid); quiet when the negated word is ordinary or positive (not hot, not happy, no money) and on the capping 'no more than'
neighbours.short: double-negative boost (no less than, not unkind)
fire: The rescue team carried no fewer than forty families across the flooded river that night.
Finishing the marathon on a broken toe was no small feat.
The guest of honor turned out to be none other than her childhood piano teacher.
His recovery after the accident was nothing short of miraculous.
The old lighthouse keeper was not unkind, just quiet and private.
If you have any questions about the course, do not hesitate to contact the office.
Every spring, the cherry trees never fail to draw crowds to the park.
The project cost no less than three million dollars to complete.
quiet: The rescue team carried about forty families across the flooded river that night.
Finishing the marathon on a broken toe was a remarkable feat.
The guest of honor turned out to be her childhood piano teacher.
His recovery after the accident was quick and steady.
The old lighthouse keeper was not happy, just quiet and private.
If you have any questions about the course, please contact the office.
Every spring, the cherry trees draw crowds to the park.
Each visitor may bring no more than two bags into the museum.
